items.question: Should we meet in my office or in the conference room?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“Should we meet in my office or in the conference room?”，自然应答是“I prefer the conference room.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（I prefer the conference room.）。
